steps.content: After using the developer solution to remove the words on top, the hidden characters behind are revealed... The attacker is indeed trying to pass on some kind of message.

Rahu caresses the letter paper. The texture does feel different in several places. This thin piece of paper seems to hold more than one secret. More clues will arrive. To fully understand it, she must humor the sender and wait a bit longer.
But even at this stage, she can still figure out some additional information...
The letter is hidden in the villa, indicating that it's for someone in the villa, or maybe Shalom herself.
After I disrupted their plan, the enemy clearly had time to adjust their strategy, but they still chose to leave behind the clues here. They knew these would fall into my hands...
Do they think that I'm loyal so I will obediently hand over these clues to my superiors? Or...
She smiles and breaks the wreath.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Did they give me these on purpose?
